have hconv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc a b) := @yui_aux_0020 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_E001 h_E002 h_T013 s (u t) (x t) (hx t ht)

  apply hh.congr
